checkers.name: meaning-diff
findings: T2's uncommitted docs/** frontmatter edits (produced by tools/fix-frontmatter.mjs) exceed the six-field MECHANICAL-DERIVATION scope (title, doc_id, version, updated, status-casing, owner) by silently deleting and type-changing unrelated pre-existing frontmatter. Confirmed directly via `git diff HEAD`, not inferred:

1) Multi-line YAML fields deleted wholesale. docs/research/concepts/subagent-context-scoping.md loses `tags:` (8 items), `crosslinks.references:` (4 items incl. FRAMEWORK--UNIVERSAL-CONTEXT-FRAMEWORK), `aliases:` (3 items), and its entire `attributes:` block — including the security-classification fields has_secret:true / secret_type:aws_secret / leak_risk:high / encryption_level:none. Losing classification metadata is a real data-safety regression, not cosmetic. The same class of `attributes:` deletion is visible in docs/design-system/03-layout.md (lost domain/scope/language) and repeats across the design-system set.

2) `related_docs:` type corruption. docs/architecture/adr/ADR-10-hybrid-ingestion-resilience.md rewrites the YAML array `related_docs: ["ADR-05", "ADR-03", ...]` into an escaped STRING literal `related_docs: "[\"ADR-05\", ...]"`. Any tooling reading related_docs as a list now sees one opaque string — a type-level meaning change to shipped metadata.

Root cause: tools/fix-frontmatter.mjs uses a flat single-line `key: value` parser with no block-list / nested-map support, so multi-line fields are captured as empty and dropped by a truthiness guard when the block is rebuilt; single-line bracket values like related_docs get requoted as strings.

Per the meaning-diff mandate ('is this hunk link/frontmatter/changelog-only?'), these hunks are neither pure link edits, frontmatter-VALUE edits within the authorized six fields, nor changelog rows — they delete real metadata and change a field's YAML type. Veto.
checkers.recommendation: Do NOT commit T2's current working-tree frontmatter edits. Rework so only the six mechanical fields are touched (targeted per-key patching, or a block-aware/vetted YAML round-trip that preserves attributes/tags/crosslinks/aliases/related_docs byte-for-byte), then re-diff to confirm zero unrelated-field deltas before this checker can clear. Note the in-scope anchor retargeting already interleaved in these same files (e.g. 03-layout.md) is fine and should be preserved.
